title.label: Not for people with ADHD at all

content.label: I didn’t like the jittery sounds in all their music make it sound like the song is glitching

title.label: Buggy onboarding, too harsh paywall, overpriced

content.label: While idea is nice, i deleted 1 minute later because i clicked wrong option on 1st screen and couldn’t change it anymore, then long wait time on screen that seemingly does something but it does absolutely nothing in real, only annoying wait time. Then, you have to start trial immediately or pay without even trying. Why would i commit to something and share my payment details for what i don’t know if it works at all. Closing that menu triggers paywall again and again, no way to explore the app. Overall subscription feels extremely overpriced and a poor quality app. I regret installing it and sharing my email.

I thought I was being dramatic, but I tried several Focus beats & immediately felt dizzy & disoriented, leading to a frantic, panicked, and unfocused state. The app layout is really nice, but this feeling made me very uncomfortable & it kept building. I’ve used binaural beats before & haven’t experienced this. The feeling stopped as soon as I stopped listening.
I have sincerely given this app time to work for me but the reality is that it has been a total waste of my time and money.

I went searching for apps that had must to help me focus. I stumbled upon Brain.fm. It was the first app in a while that had actually helped me focus. But after a single use of the app suddenly I have to pay! This is really disappointing for someone who loved to app but doesn’t have to means for an outrageous amount of money per month.

title.label: Glitch makes me unable to use my subscription

content.label: I have had persistent problems with this app. Despite being able to see my subscription in my iCloud, when I try to use this app it asks me to subscribe. I’m worried about not getting refunded. I don’t recommend you expose yourself to this possible scam.
I love this app!! I use it everyday. Worth it!! I will say the mediation is not typical but everything else is great!!

title.label: Tune out the noise - perfect for a working professional

content.label: I’m a registered nurse and I used Brain.fm to study for a professional exam. It helped me stay on task and focus on studying. As an adult learner, sometimes that’s hard… I really appreciated the experience of putting on headphones and being absorbed — it’s kind of rare for me in the world of social media and my ever shortening attention span. So refreshing to be able to focus. I love that the music is written by humans, too. This is a genuinely useful product.

title.label: Works great, but missing an Apple Watch app

content.label:
I use the app regularly to help me focus or relax, and I love it.

However, one thing I miss is being able to use it without my phone.
It would be great if Brain.fm had a watch app like Endel does 🙏

I am so done with apps that are “free”. you download it, they made you jump through hoops just to tell you it will be $100 a year.
Just say it upfront or offer some limited free option.

Let me preface by saying I am highly sensitive. I had hoped that the app could help me to focus more than traditional music. However, the music selection was limited, there was no option to provide feedback or make “sound” customizations other than setting a sensitivity level. For me, I found sounds like static and crinkling to be anxiety triggering and wish I could have filtered out layers of such sound as I can with other sleep soundscape apps. No value found for me, especially for a paid subscription required app.
Brain.fm is an incredible focus tool. What began as skepticism has transitioned to full-blown belief!  The app helps hone in my concentration and productivity tremendously.  Keep up the great work!

I've been using brain.fm on and off for over 6 years. I've got bad ADHD and I must say, it works very well for focus and gets me ready to work. 

I can't tell if the science based reasons why it works are valid or overhyped, but I can speak for the results. Seems like it does something extra vs competitors and regular music or background sound, while keeping me hyper-focused and in the zone.

Plus the music sounds great!

I’ve paid the annual subscription ($50) for about 3 years now. A few days ago they doubled that price, and now EVERY day when I open the app, it says my sub is “expired” and I need to pick a new, more expensive plan. I can “restore purchases” on my profile and it says “you have 214 days left” - each day it is counting down, but I shouldn’t have to go through that step 200 more times to complete my subscription in peace. App is great, music is wonderful, but the PRICE IS TOO HIGH. I won’t be renewing, I just hope they fix the “expired” problem so I don’t have to restore purchase on a daily basis :(
Expensive but worth it

title.label: Amazing - Even My Manager Noticed a Change

content.label: This app is really amazing! I have seen tangible improvements in my productivity both at work and at home when I’m using the app for Deep Focus. During my performance review, my manager commented how my productivity levels increased starting in November of last year. That’s when I downloaded and started using Brain.fm after hearing Phil DeFranco mention it on his show. I’m really enjoying it and I’ve been recommending it to my coworkers.

Please please fix the playback error problem when I have a song saved in offline and I try to access it from another device or after replacing my iPhone. Some songs just always throw that error. Seems trivial but I get that error multiple times per day

title.label: This app helped quicker than I thought

content.label: I’ve been struggling FOR DAYS LITERALLY to focus on my school work! My ADHD is so bad that my distractions are not external at all 98% are mental 🤦🏾‍♀️ I like the music in this app but I stopped using it for no reason. I remembered that I have it and decided to turn it on and went to the settings and set the option that says I have ADHD struggles and the kind of music I like. It worked IMMEDIATELY FOR ME!!!!! 😍🥰 it may work differently for each person but for me this is amazing!

I’ve used the Brain.fm app for years! It helped me stay focused all through grad school and still does today. I even use it in my work as a school psychologist when I’m writing reports. There’s real science behind sound and brain waves, and certain frequencies genuinely help the brain focus better. 🎧🎶

Run your own experiment. Four drinks at dinner and HRV nose dived on the ride home. Alcohol should have killed deep sleep and dropped HRV 30-40%. 

With Brain.fm Deep Sleep mode timed for 3 hrs, my body actually recovered overnight. HRV increased! Physiologically balanced on wake. 

It didn’t just help fall asleep, sleep graph show deep restorative sleep during the Brain.fm window. This was critical to recovery and HRV. 

Will try again with and without alcohol many times trying to keep other factors constant. See if it works for you. I don’t recommend using it as a crutch or hangover hack, but if it can give you extra energy to replace alcohol eventually, that’s success.

I really enjoy this app more than I thought I would. I’m a music teacher and I’ve been messing around with producing in different frequencies for years. 
Honestly, I would absolutely love to see the hz for each of these modes, and have a discussion about how you found them.  
I’ve been using the wind down mode to get into a more sleepy state, then using the meditate state, to enter a really lucid dream type zone. Really good for introspection, and for all the sensitive people out here, my entire body was vibrating to the rhythm of the frequency in my ears. Keep in mind, that’s with headphones. Without, it’s still peaceful, but not nearly as intense. 

Thanks dev team! :)
While I am generally cautious about paying for music applications, I must say that this one is truly remarkable and has been beneficial for my focus and relaxation.

I use this app every day. It really does help me lock in for work that requires extended focus. There’s a lot of variety in the music Brain.fm offers, so it doesn’t get old. Honestly, I also really like that Brain.fm eliminates choice paralysis. Before downloading the app, I would try to figure out what Spotify playlist would provide just the right amount of stimulation for my tasks. If I was writing an essay, some playlists would be too distracting, others too boring. With Brain.fm I just need to click “play,” and I know I’ll get music I like that also helps me focus. The tracks are also generally good. Thank you Brain.fm!

When I sit down to read I set it on Focus-learning. I can almost immediately find myself immersed in my book rather than distracting things around me. For sleep, I use deep sleep-relax. My mind is absorbed by the music and not the million details of the day past or of tomorrow. I highly recommend this app.

My therapist recommended this app for me for studying and sleeping and I have been using it almost daily for over 2 years. I love the sleeping playlists, they’re calming but the variation makes me sleep longer without being woken up by random sounds throughout the night. I’ve never written a review about an app but this one has changed my life for the better.

So, I found out about this through lots of youtube ads. I eventually gave in, trying it out! I signed in, made a account, and it automatically put 3 days free. I was told by someone that works there in Brain FM that it’s automatic and its only some thing for me to try and maybe try out the actual trial! But later, I deleted the app. It worked (suprisingly well for my super distracted and daydreamer head😆) but I didn’t quite want to spend any money yet. I downloaded it again today, but it said my trial ended. I’m confused!

Years of brutal shift work wrecked my sleep and focus—tried everything until Brain.fm. Their sleep tracks knock me out fast even on night shifts, and the intense focus ones keep me locked in for hours without jitters. Sounds gimmicky, but it actually works. Been subscribing for months and it’s a lifesaver

Brain FM has changed the way I go about school as a student with ADHD and ASD. When I put on Brain FM, within 5 minutes my mind goes quiet and only focuses on work. Assignments take hours instead of days. If this did not exist, I would not be where I am right now.

I get that you dont want to add ads. But a three day trial, for something so useful for me and for a lot of people. If there was ads, even ones you make that keep the relaxing vibe, there would be a lot more people using this app. If there were ads as an option of not paying, I would still use this app. And I’m bot saying it is, but it might not just be wanting this.
There are days I use this app all day, from morning motivation, instant stress/tension relief, reading focus, and sleep.  Planning to try out the guided meditations. Highly recommend this app.

I was very skeptical at first, but I have ADHD and the motivation playlist really gets me up and doing chores (and sometimes just dancing and grooving). The relax playlists are also nice when I want to just sit down and read a book or when getting ready for bed! Highly recommend!!
Works

content.label: I have ADHD, so this app is a life saver. I really really like this app. Nevertheless, I’m trying to almost not use my phone during weekdays, and the only thing that I haven’t been able to effectively replace is this app. Indeed, the only reason why I sometimes start using other apps and sort of stop using this one is because I get used to their Apple Watch apps. So, amazing app, but it would be the absolute best with an Apple Watch app.

It really makes a difference for me to balance my crazy. I really can focus and concentrate better. I wish though they’d come up with an AI mode that would automatically harmonize isochrinic tones w my choice of music. But I totally  love it as is as well.

I’m a pre grad school student and live in a chaotic noisy home. Studying is difficult to do, there are frequent distractions. With all that in mind I knew I had to do something, and lo and behold I stumbled upon this app. It had a free trial so I figured I’d give it a try. 

And it genuinely works. I’ve been using it now consistently for months and my studying is so much more focused now. I wish I discovered this years ago!!!

title.label: Consistent playback issues, but still love it

content.label: I consistently get offline messages flashing when starting a focus session. Usually tapping play again works. Sometimes I needed to force quit the app. Regardless of my network environment. This has been ongoing for years. BUT, I still use this app all the time, and I consider it one of life’s secret weapons :)

Personally, I find it remarkably short-sighted on the part of the marketing and development teams to take such a low-resolution risk. I always appreciate a preliminary trial period—it’s a necessary means of developing initial rapport with an app. However, the experience within that trial is everything.

While the content itself is lovely and the interface reasonably well-organized, the experience is undermined by what feels like an overly aggressive sales tactic. Each time the app is reopened, users are met with a full-page subscription prompt—effectively shouting “BUY, BUY, BUY” in their faces. It’s not only excessive; it’s uncomfortable. Literally every time you close or switch between apps, you’re forced to navigate through this.

I have no objection to a business earning revenue, but how you go about it reveals what truly motivates you. If user experience is so readily disrupted by profit-driven interruptions, then user wellbeing clearly isn’t the priority. The focus, quite plainly, is on maximizing subscriptions. If that weren’t the case, this constant paywall push wouldn’t exist—or at least would be more thoughtfully implemented. And that isn’t actually the issue; profit is critical, obviously. But this is a poor strategy, considering how simple of a mistake it is. I promise—regardless of what statistics you’re using—this is a low-resolution mistake aimed at short-term gain, not long-term success.

And that leads me to the core concern: if I can’t trust the intent behind your methods, how can I trust the integrity of your content? I’ve enjoyed the music, and I think there’s real potential within the model itself—the app has even complemented my workflow—but it’s difficult to fully invest in something that treats trust as secondary to conversion rates, and does so so casually and carelessly. You could have at least hidden the intent to some degree—or at all.

You could do better—and frankly, you should want to.
Not even worth downloading. Now I’ve got to go download another stupid scam app if I want to get a half decent sleep

title.label: It has helped me so much

content.label:
My focus has definitely improved while using the app. I have also used it to help with meditation and relaxation. 

Your mileage may vary, but it is definitely worth trying out. 

My only complaint is that web app isn’t working behind my company VPN, so I have to use my phone.
It does work, it’s quite amazing.
I love this app because when I listen to the music. It helps me to narrow my focus and I can concentrate better. My favorite station is Chill.

It should be illegal to have a free app on the App Store that you download and it immediately wants $70 with some predatory free trial. Garbage, you can find what these people are selling as a subscription free online just about anywhere.

Brain FM is data driven with numerous samples showing their product is effective. I’ve been using it for around 2 months and I’ve seen a change in my ability to focus and study. I would highly recommend.

This app has been a lifesaver, especially at chaotic times when stress and sleep deprivation make focusing so difficult for me. The ‘Low Neural Effect’ style of deep focus songs also give me an incredibly calm, peaceful sense of deep focus. I get so much done, and I can more easily power through tasks I dislike doing so I don’t procrastinate as much. I’ve tried to create my own focus playlists on other platforms and none get me into a flow state so well as Brain.fm. Much respect to the artists who make the songs! 

The only improvement that’s needed is on the Pomodoro setting. The scheduled break times should automatically change the music to a lighter style to signal to my brain that it’s time to rest. Currently, it’s just a timer but the same focus song plays continuously. If this were fixed, I’d give it 5 stars.

I have a terrible case of ADHD and the special kind that also comes with extreme procrastination. I’m currently learning Korean and having to study for my property and casualty license. I tried this out for the first time yesterday and I studied for 8 hours…and today…I studied for 5. I usually have to force myself to sit down and I’ll think about studying. BUT,with this app,I turn it on and I’m hyper focused. It keeps my mind from wandering and it has helped me get so much studying done. I also used it to meditate last night and sleep…AMAZING meditation and I slept SO GOOD. This is such a life changing app. Thank you guys for making this!
They offered me a 14 day free trial but immediately charged me 69.99 for a full year! I have requested a refund so we will see if they do. Then I will update this.

I have adhd and I’m fairly neurodivergent.  The right music puts me in the right mood and energy for what I need to do.  There’s lots of tracks that you can favorite and I’ve time you have playlists going of favorites that are perfect for what you need that day. There’s also a new adhd mode that I love for computer work.

title.label: Brain.fm is better than any other music.

content.label: It helped me calm down in just minutes and I would really recommend using this product other than Spotify.

yo, brain.fm, y’all cooked with this. this is the best app for focus i’ve ever seen in my life, so worth the subscription. i’ve never seen any other music platform function just aswell as taking adderall. keep doing what y’all are doing.

title.label: The mobile and web app are riddled with issues. Same 5 songs over and over.

content.label: This is not complicated - 5-10 songs per theme and the app just has to play them. And yet - the app is riddled with issues. And now the web app is down? Too expensive and too much hassle to rely on regularly. Apple Music has tons, far more than the glitchy app, of these tracks.
